_comment: Reach — native wrapper around the phone web app in apps/reach/ui/static. `npm run sync:www` copies that app (plus shared/ui) into ./www before every `cap sync`; nothing in www/ is edited by hand. server.androidScheme http + cleartext and android.allowMixedContent let the WebView talk plain http:// and ws:// to the agents on the LAN (docs/reach-api.md §1); android:usesCleartextTraffic in AndroidManifest.xml lets the OS network stack allow it. ios.contentInset never: the page handles its own insets with env(safe-area-inset-*).
